'''Ōyamazumi Shrine''' (大山祇神社, Ōyamazumi Jinja)

Ōyamazumi Shrine is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}} dedicated to {{ill|Ōyamatsumi|en|Ōyamatsumi|qid=Q386563|qid=Q386563|lt=Ōyamatsumi|1=Ōyamatsumi}}, associated with the [[Mishima–Ōyamazumi cult]]. As of 1973, 897 shrines existed across Japan, from [[:en:Hokkaidō|Hokkaidō]] to {{ill|Kagoshima Prefecture|en|Kagoshima Prefecture|qid=Q15701|lt=Kagoshima Prefecture|1=Kagoshima Prefecture}}. According to a 1995 survey by the Association of Shinto Shrines, there were 293 shrines, while a 2019 study by {{ill|Kanazawa Institute of Technology|en|Kanazawa Institute of Technology|qid=Q6360885|lt=Kanazawa Institute of Technology|1=Kanazawa Institute of Technology}} reported 960 shrines. The shrine may also be written as '''Ōyamazumi Shrine''', '''Ōyamatsumi Shrine''', '''Yamazumi Shrine''', or '''Yamatsumi Shrine'''.

The head shrine is the {{ill|Ōyamazumi Shrine|ja|大山祇神社 (今治市大三島)|Ōyamazumi Shrine=Ōyamazumi Shrine|lt=Ōyamazumi Shrine (Ōmishima)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōyamazumi Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} in [[:en:Ōmishima|Ōmishima]], [[:en:Imabari|Imabari]], {{ill|Ehime Prefecture|en|Ehime Prefecture|qid=Q123376|lt=Ehime Prefecture|1=Ehime Prefecture}}. Other related shrine names under the [[Mishima–Ōyamazumi cult]] include {{ill|Mishima Taisha|lt=Mishima Taisha|lt=Mishima Shrine|ja|三島神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mishima Shrine|qq=}}.
